text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 104,133 to 94,220.75, so I need to prioritize protecting retirement savings and avoiding excessive risk.","Several declines came while I made no trades; holding is not automatically safer, so I should review the portfolio regularly and respond thoughtfully to changing risks.","I should avoid reacting just to a stock’s gain or loss versus my cost, and keep decisions measured, diversified, and consistent with my need for stability and cash."]}
